batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c SK Warne b AD Mascarenhas

batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c Kamran Khan b AD Mascarenhas

batting.name: TM Dilshan
batting.dismissal: c SA Asnodkar b MM Patel

batting.name: PC Valthaty
batting.dismissal: c DL Vettori b A Mishra

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c PJ Sangwan b A Mishra

batting.name: SK Warne
batting.dismissal: st KD Karthik b A Mishra

balls.text: keeps it full in the block-hole, digs it out as he gets a thickish edge through square leg. A chip comes off the bat and Sangwan smiling away as he walks back to the pavilion as Delhi innings comes to an end.
makes room and looks to take the cover off the ball, Mishra back away too far and Kamran Khan breaks the stumps.
looking for the big shot on the onside, gets an inside edge to the off side for a single.
keeps it full outside the off stump, slices it and well stopped at backward point.
makes room, plays and misses.
Kamran Khan comes round the wicket and Manhas times the ball well through covers to the fence, a valiant dive but cannot stop it.
slower delivery and Mishra looking to give the kitchen sink, misses it and through to the keeper.
a quick bouncer from Munaf, wonderful bowling, good thinking as the long on was brought in and fine leg dropped back.
full and bit wide, Mishra reaches it and blocks to the off side.
makes room and Vettori misses a full toss, Munaf strikes the middle stump.
strikes the pad outside the line as Manhas looks to play through the onside, they scramble through for a leg bye.
moves across way outside the off stump and looks to work it to the onside, Munaf does well to bowl a slower one, off the pad.
pitches on the leg stump and spins away, Manhas stands in the crease and flays at the delivery and gets beaten.
slider from Warne, cuts and misses.
googly from Warne, cut to the sweeper for a single.
flatter and quicker, Manhas plays close to the pads as he cuts to point.
swings it again this time in the air to deep backward square leg and one bounce to the fence.
goes all the way as Warne tosses it up outside the off stump and Manhas lofts it high and over the fielder to long off fence for maximum.
on a length and Vettori works to deep midwicket for couple of runs as Quiney runs around to field the ball.
stands still and drives well through extra cover, it was fuller and in the slot, well put away.
does well this time, moves across well outside the off stump and plays it to the on side through square leg to the fence, picks up the gap nicely.
plays it down to third man for a single.
strikes the pad and it is sliding down, an appeal turned down.
works it through square leg to the deep.
slow turner from Warne and drops it short, pulls it around to deep midwicket.
defended watchfully to the off side.
waits for the turn, cuts well to deep backward point, good fielding in the deep running around.
cuts and misses outside the off stump.

and Warne strikes, floats up the delivery and pitches outside the leg stump and de Villiers looking for the slog sweep, misses it and gets hit on the pad, loud appeal and given, de Villiers is unlucky.
sweeps well to midwicket fence and Smith fails to pick up the ball in the background, brings up the 50! for de Villiers.
drops it short and de Villiers cannot put it away, pulls it to deep midwicket.
works it through midwicket for a single.
looking to work it through the onside, takes it low on the pad.
off the pad to the onside, looking for the single, gets back in time.
plays and misses as Vettori looks to cut.
uses his feet and plays it through square leg to the deep for a single.
tosses it full outside the off stump, driven to the sweeper for a single.
plays inside-out to extra cover.
down the track and de Villiers not to the pitch off the ball, takes it on the pad.
full toss played down the ground to long off.
tosses it up bit fuller and driven down the ground to long off.
driven down the ground to long on.
looks to play across the line, gets an inside edge to the off side.
a fumble at backward point, single taken.
pushes through the off side.
played down the ground to long on, some more confusion.
a run out chance as de Villiers is stranded and Pathan fails to catch the ball.
and immediately de Villiers down the track and lofts it high over wide long on fence for maximum, just got over the fielder.
works it to deep square leg.
works it through midwicket for couple of runs.
plays inside out over extra cover for another boundary, wonderful footwork and touch from de Villiers.
forced away through point, just a single
fulltoss outside the off stump and Vettori hammers it to the wide long-on fence, as easy as it gets
full and on the pads, worked away through square leg for a single
line and length delivery on the middle and off stump line, de Villiers leans forward and taps it away towards point, the fielder is bit deep and they scamper through for a single
bit of extra bounce and de Villiers is beaten outside the off stump, going for the cut
good length delivery outside the off stump and de Villiers finds the fielder at cover
forced away off the back-foot, through covers for a single, score trickles up to 68
short of a good length delivery outside the off stump, defended watchfully
driven down to long-off for an easy single, if that is the strategy they have come up with then...
single to end the over, full and on the pads, de Villiers opens up and punches it down to long-on for a single

tossed up, pitched outside the leg stump and turning across, a Warne special - de Villiers tries to work it away on the leg side but fails to make contact. Loud appeal for lbw turned down and rightly so.
driven hard but straight to the fielder at cover
forced away through midwicket for a brace, fielder in the deep is bit late and they rush back for the second
googly and its bit too wide, turning away from the left-hander and Vettori taps it down to short third man
pushed away for a single
well done Munaf, full and outside the off stump, Vettori steps out and is beaten
caught but its a no-ball! good length and angling across, Vettori is sucked into the drive and the edge goes straight to Ware at wideish first slip.
good length delivery outside the off stump, Vettori tries to work it away but ends up with an inside edge and the ball rolls back to the bowler
full and on the stumps, driven down to mid-off and they scamper through for a single
short of a good length delivery outside the off stump, Vettori stands tall and punches it down to long-off for a single
another fuller length delivery outside the off stump and de Villiers this time finds the gap on the off side
fuller length delivery outside the off stump and Vettori drives it through covers

shot! tossed up outside the off stump and turning away, de Villiers pushes forward, nicely gets to the pitch of the delivery and drives it through covers. Diving effort in the deep ends in vain. Boundary to end a successful over
late cut to third man fetches another single
worked away on the leg side
worked away on the off side, they take on the fielder at cover and adds a single to the total

And he strikes straightaway! flighted delivery on the middle and leg stump line, Karthik looks to turn it away on the leg side but fails miserably. Ball clips the leading edge and lobs back, Warne moves forward few steps and takes it comfortably. That's the end of that
tossed up and turning away sharply, de Villiers waits for the ball to turn and taps it away behind point
good length delivery outside the off stump, no width offered and de Villiers finds the fielder at point. Mascarenhas has finished his quota.
pitched up, bit of swing but the its too full to trouble the batsman. Karthik pushes forward and punches it through the gap between the cover fielders
driven off the front-foot and an easy single to deep cover
pushed off the front-foot to the cover point region
again bit of width offered outside the off stump, de Villiers nicely taps it down to third man
good length delivery outside the off stump, Karthik runs it past the fielder at slip. Not a recommended shot, given the situation
clipped away off the pads, gets it fine and the ball races away to the fine leg fence. de Villiers is looking good. A successful over comes to an end
Another one bites the dust! Short delivery on the stumps and Dilshan pulls it away high towards deep midwicket. Asnodkar runs around and nicely settled under it. Royals on top here
forced away on the off side
good length delivery on the middle and leg stump line, de Villiers stays back and clips it away well in front of square leg
again short, this time bit too wide outside the off stump and Dilshan cuts it away to deep backward point for a single
starts off with a short rising delivery on the middle and off stump line, Dilshan stands his ground and tries to cut it away through point but fails to make contact
plays behind the wicket on the off side to Warne at slip.
pushes in the gap through cover for a single.
lovely timing, punches nicely through point and fielder running around cannot stop it.
pushes forward and plays square of the wicket on the off side, fielder in quickly prevents the single.
plays and misses outside the off stump, that was close.
mistimes the ball back to the bowler.
short and de Villiers upper cuts over the slips to third man fence.
angled away too wide outside the off stump.
fuller and driven back firmly and Kamran Khan stops it well on his follow-through.
shorter in length and cramps de Villiers, no room for him to free his arms, bowling at a good pace is Kamran Khan.
full toss on the legs turned away to square leg.
shorter in length and angled away, de Villiers cuts and misses.
fuller delivery pushed to the off side for a single.

Shewag too falls, as he mishits the ball high in the air to mid-on, Kamran Khan calls for the catch and takes it well. That ball went so high that Karmran had to wait for ages for the ball to come down.
no stopping Sehwag, swings it to the square leg fence.
pushes in the gap through cover to the sweeper for a single.
fuller and moving away, Gambhir bit casual, drives and gets the outside edge and Warne at first slip dives to his left to take a wonderful catch.
miscues to the onside for a single.
this time Sehwag down the track and lofts the ball down the ground to long off fence.
walks down the track and chips it over square leg to the fence.
Sehwag drives from the crease and an outside edge down to third man.
full on the legs and turned to square leg, well fielded.
slashes outside the off stump and misses.
drops it to the off side for a quick single.
misfield at point as Gambhir cuts for couple of runs.
works it to midwicket and that ends the first over, 7 runs of the first over.
slower delivery and Sehwag plays behind point.
looking for another big shot, this time he miscues to midwicket.
stands in the crease and flicks it high and over backward square leg for maximum, no wasting time.
pushes square of the wicket and takes off for a tight single, direct hit would have been interesting.
left alone outside the off stump.
makes room and swings it down the ground to long on fence for the winning run.
short delivery down the leg side, nudged down to fine leg for couple of runs. The scores are level.
fuller and strikes the pad, question asked, the ball pitches outside the leg stump.
full toss hit down the ground to long off for a single.
another short delivery and Pathan strikes maximum, pulls well over the midwicket fence this time, wonderful striking.
short and Pathan does the best, pulls well and high over the fielder at deep square leg and over the fence for maximum.
full toss worked to deep midwicket.
keeps it fuller and Smith fails to get the ball away, inside edges onto the pads.
down the track and plays across the line, goes over the stumps to keeper, a terrible shot.
comes forward and opens the face off the bat and plays square of the wicket on the off side, a dot ball.
full toss hit down the ground to long on and Sangwan does well this time to field the ball, Smith calls Pathan for the second.
a terrible delivery, too short and Pathan puts it high and over the long on fence for maximum, goes a long way into the stands.
dropped, hits it high in the air to long on and Sangwan fails hold on to the catch.
short ball mishit to midwicket, a tight single, direct hit would have been interesting, Smith is lucky to be there.
Mishra oversteps, worked to the onside.
googly is too short and Smith puts it away nicely through extra cover and ball goes past the fielder to the fence.
once again plays across the line to deep square leg, this time Nannes does well to stop it.
swings it across the line to deep midwicket and Gambhir moves quickly in the deep, puts in a dive and makes a good save.
good smart batting, plays with soft hands to the off side for a single.
this time Pathan connects it well, swings it high and hard over the ropes at midwicket.
tossed up delivery and Pathan goes for the slog sweep and mishits it high in the air to fine leg and drops just short of the fielder.
flat delivery and Smith pushes down the ground to long on.
opens the face off the bat and plays it down to third man.
another short delivery on body, off the glove to the onside.
short delivery outside the off stump and Smith chops it down to third man for a single.
short ball and Pathan looking to pull the ball gets hit on the helmet, they scramble for a tight run.
Nannes keeps it full on the stumps, mishits to mid on.
played along the ground straight to the fielder at midwicket to a full delivery.
on the middle and off stump line, Pathan comes down the track and works it away through midwicket.
short off a good length delivery, Smith plays late and taps it away behind the wicket on the off side
punched down to long-off
played away off the back-foot to the backward square leg region and they come back for the second, the fielder misses the pick-up under pressure and no damage is done
defended down on the leg side
taps it away towards gully and they scamper through for a dangerous single, Dilshan moving in fails to hit the stumps and Pathan makes it across safely. Direct hit and Pathan would have been history
fuller length delivery and Pathan hammers it straight back past the bowler to long-off, poor fielding in the deep and the ball rolls over the ropes. End of a massive over for the Royals
played straight back to the bowler
another one! flat delivery outside the off stump, once again Pathan slogs across the line and the ball files off the meat of the bat to the midwicket fence. That's more like it
outside the off stump, Pathan swings across the line - good old slog sweep and the ball flies over the midwicket fence
short delivery outside the off stump, Pathan waits on this one and plays it away to wide long-on. The first run is taken quickly and they scamper back for the second
turned away off the back-foot to the midwicket region
short of a good length delivery on the middle and off stump line, Pathan plays across the line and the ball goes through to the keeper, didn't miss the stumps by much
fuller length delivery outside the off stump, Smith moves across a bit and clips it away towards midwicket for a single
slower delivery and this one kicked up after hitting the deck, Smith is early into the shot and the ball zips past the outside edge
short of a good length delivery on the pads, Pathan stays back and taps it away into the gap between mid-on and midwicket
angled across the right-hander, Pathan cuts it away straight to the fielder at point
taps it away past gully for a single
swings and misses, Karthik collects the ball and whips off the bails, Warne drags his foot outside the crease, referred to the third umpire, OUT comes up on the screen and Warne has to go.
looking to work it through the onside, takes it low on the pad.
driven down the ground to long on.
a loose shot from Jadeja, tosses it up and he hits in the air straight down the throat of Sangwan at long off.
hit in the air down the ground to long off, comes back for the second run, good running from Smith.
works it behind square leg for a single.
pushes to cover straight to the fielder.
cuts and gets an inside edge past the stumps and to short fine leg, direct hit would have been interesting.
chops it away to the sweeper in the deep on the off side.
moves back and works it to deep square leg.
strikes the pad as he looks to play to the onside, loud appeal turned down, was a close thing. Smith is lucky to be there.
cut away to the sweeper on the off side.
googly from Mishra, the batsman and keeper fail to read it, goes to the fence for byes.
chops it down behind point for another single.
turns it behind square leg on the front foot.
googly from Mishra, Smith gets squared up.
tossed up on the legs and worked to deep backward square leg for another single.
cuts it behind point to the deep, good running from Jadeja, comes back for the second run.
slower and bit fuller, pushes to the right of backward point away from Dilshan who dives yet again but fails to stop it cleanly.
short delivery and Smith moves across to the off side and works it through square leg to pick up an easy single.
opens the face off the bat and runs it down to the right of backward point, Dilshan desperately dives but fails to stop it.
again too wide outside the off stump, Jadeja sensibly lets it go.
short from Sangwan, Jadeja upper cuts it over the slips to third man fence.
back of a length and bit slower, Smith waits for it and opens the face off the bat and plays to deep point.
too wide outside the off stump and Smith chases it, lucky he did not get an edge.
short and wide, cut away in the air to the sweeper.
forced away through square on the off side and he is off the mark first ball. End of a fine first over
worked away for a single and that brings Jadeja on strike
another one! tossed up close to the off stump line and turning away, Valthaty gets forward and hits it straight to Vettori at long-off. Horrible shot to say the least.
worked away well wide of that man at midwicket, easy single taken
worked away off the back-foot, straight to the fielder at short midwicket
full and on the stump, Smith pushes forward and defends it back to the bowler
worked away on the leg side, played with soft hands and a quick single is taken
good length delivery outside the off stump, Smith moves across a bit and defends it with a straight bat
pitched up on the pads and Valthaty turns it down to fine leg for a single
another line and length delivery, Valthaty stays back and taps it down on the leg side
defended watchfully
short of a good length delivery and this one came back in, Valthaty was clueless and the ball zips past the inside edge to the keeper
good length delivery outside the off stump, Smith safely plays it away on the off side
played down to mid-on and a suicidal run is called for, direct hit at the bowler's end from Mishra, who moved in quickly from from the edge of the circle, and Asnodkar is history
pitched up on the pads and Asnodkar leans forward and clips it over the backward square leg fence, good clean hit
on the middle and leg stump line, Asnodkar gets behind the line and plays it down
punched down to long-on
good length and angling across the right-hander - Asnodkar pushes forward and hits through the line, ball clips the outside edge and flies away to the backward point fence.
worked away to fine leg, end of a successful over
worked away with no real intention
pushed away towards point, Asnodkar calls for the single and is sent back

good length delivery, this one kept a bit low and came in with the angle. Quiney goes for the pull and gets beaten by a long way, ball thuds into the pad and Nehra's throat bursting appeal is upheld by umpire Baxter.
good length delivery, in the slot outside the off stump and Quiney safely plays it away towards gully
forced away towards point, no room for a single there
good length delivery, this one came in with the angle. Smith ends up with a leading edge, was looking to play it away off the back-foot
defended off the back-foot to cover region
cut away hard to point and a diving stop from Dilshan cuts off a certain boundary
short and wide outside the off stump and that's dispatched to the backward point fence. Cracker of a shot, had four written over it the moment it left the bat
this one hits the deck and jumps up a bit, Smith feels for it outside the off stump and the ball whips past the outside edge
full and drifting onto the pads. Smith reads it well, leans forward and clips it away through square leg for a super boundary
edged and this one fall short of the man at first slip. Smith once again beaten by the away movement there.
punched away towards point, early call from Quiney and they decide not to go for the single
edged and down to third man for a boundary, Nehra gets another one to swing away from the left-hander, Smith pushes at it and the ball races away off the outside edge
another line and length delivery, bit of extra bounce. Smith gets behind the line and defends it down
pitched wide outside the off stump and swinging away further
short of a good length delivery, close to the off stump line and Smith defends it down on the off side
short of a good length delivery outside the off stump, left through to the keeper
short of a good length delivery, this one came back in with the angle and is defended down on the leg side
in the slot outside the off stump and Quiney thuds it through covers for the first boundary of the innings
way outside the off stump
good length delivery, pitched outside the off stump and swinging away, no shot offered
quicker delivery but this one is directed down the leg side and that's a wide
bit of swing and that goes through to the keeper
